title: Two DOC field-table refusals read a redundant grffldEnd annotation as a structural fact; the five duplicate-style refusals are correct and already have a documented lenient path
decision: retained, correctness fix in litchi-doc; five of the seven refusals confirmed correct and unchanged
code_state: crates/litchi-doc/src/parts/fields only; two refusals removed from build_fields, doc comments added to FieldEndFlags and Field, two tests changed in the fields test module; no public API, no error type, no limit, no output byte and no dependency changed; no new unsafe
reason_codes: grffldEnd.fHasSep and .fNested restate what the FieldList grammar of the Plcfld (MS-DOC 2.8.25) already fixes; the reader derives separator presence and nesting depth from the marker sequence and never consults the bits, so a disagreement is evidence about the producer rather than about the fields, while costing the caller the whole document

the bytes show both files are structurally intact: watermark.doc is a TOC containing five HYPERLINK fields, each end marker grffldEnd=0x80 with fNested clear although nested, markers balanced and CPs strictly increasing; poi test.doc is one ' SEQ CHAPTER \h \r 1' field with no separator marker and no separator character, end marker grffldEnd=0x80
fNested is set on none of the 98 field end markers in the 57-fixture corpus, including the only five that are genuinely nested; fHasSep tracks the structure on 97 of 98

both bits are still parsed, still stored on FieldEndFlags and still written back, so FieldStoryTable::to_plcf_bytes stays byte-identical and the quirk is preserved rather than repaired; the write side (writer/fields.rs:205) still derives both bits from the structure it emits, which is ADR 0006's reader/writer division

the duplicate-style refusals are correct: MS-DOC 2.9 requires style names and aliases to be unique, all five fixtures duplicate 'Absatz-Standardschriftart' across istd 10 and istd 15, and OpenOptions::with_leniency(Leniency::TolerateStylesheetDefects) already admits all five on the unmodified base

accepted_evidence.structure: probe mode fld-dump decodes each Plcfld straight from the Table stream, independently of litchi-doc's field parser, and annotates every end marker's fNested and fHasSep against the structure; run on both witness fixtures and on all 57 .doc fixtures for the population table
accepted_evidence.stylesheets: probe mode stsh-dump lists every style's index, invariant id, kind, name and aliases through a tolerant parse, marking duplicates; run on all five duplicate-style fixtures plus both witness fixtures
accepted_evidence.leniency: probe mode open-leniency reports the strict and lenient open outcome for all seven fixtures on the unmodified base commit
accepted_evidence.differential: change 0596's digest-doc oracle verbatim over all 57 .doc fixtures under test-data/: open outcome or exact refusal Debug text, text length and hash, paragraph count, paragraph_count(), a hash over every paragraph's Debug form, section count and hash, get_all_subdoc_ranges() hash, FIB raw_data length and hash
accepted_evidence.differential_cross_check: the before digest is byte-identical to change 0596's retained after digest after path normalization
accepted_evidence.counts: strace -c syscall census for one eager open on two field-bearing fixtures, before and after; callgrind isolation pairs (10 and 110 opens differenced, divided by 100) on the same two fixtures
accepted_evidence.plausibility: Document::text() under TolerateStylesheetDefects compared against LibreOffice 26.2.5.2's txt:Text (encoded):UTF8 export, on normalized word sequences, for the five fixtures leniency admits

accepted_costs.no_fixture_newly_admitted: the corpus contains no file whose only defect is a stale grffldEnd bit, so the reach gain is unwitnessed here; the two witness fixtures reach a further refusal instead
accepted_costs.detection_now_silent: a disagreeing bit is no longer surfaced as an error; a caller who cares must compare Field::end_flags against Field::has_separator and Field::nesting_depth, which the doc comments now say
accepted_costs.matrix_case_removed: one case left the malformed-PLCF matrix because it was only invalid through these bits; two structurally invalid cases replace it
accepted_costs.instruction_counts: the callgrind deltas are code-layout drift, not the removed work; a first pass through a driver that differed only by one unused subcommand put the larger fixture's delta at the opposite sign
accepted_costs.narrow_detection_given_up: a disagreement could still indicate a separator marker dropped from an otherwise balanced field, or an enclosing begin/end pair lost together; the reader cannot tell that apart from a stale annotation, and after this change such a field reads as separator-less with its result text inside code_range(), with end_flags still carrying the producer's contradicting claim

known_gaps.producer_identity: this record does not claim Microsoft Word writes either disagreement; watermark.doc is an OpenOffice.org/LibreOffice export (WW8Num*z* styles, __RefHeading__ bookmarks) and poi test.doc has no SummaryInformation and no identifying stamp, correcting change 0587's 'ordinary Word files'
known_gaps.specification: no copy of [MS-DOC] is retained in this repository; whether it states a MUST for fNested/fHasSep consistency is unverified, and the disposition rests on the bits being redundant with a validated structure rather than on the absence of a MUST
known_gaps.unmasked_refusals: watermark.doc now fails on 'bookmark ibkl values must be unique and in range' and poi test.doc on 'malformed SPRM sequence: truncated SPRM opcode at byte 3'; both were decoded and provisionally read as also stricter than the format, and both are queued rather than decided (follow-ups.md)
known_gaps.duplicate_style_shape: the duplicate-style disposition rests on five files sharing one producer and one duplicated name
known_gaps.facade_leniency: OpenOptions carries the leniency, but the litchi facade's own .doc ingress opens with defaults, so a facade caller has no way to reach the lenient path; unchanged here because this brief is scoped to litchi-doc
